COLDWAR_CHI_replace_in_council = {
	# council and P5 arrays are positional: China takes Taiwan's index
	for_each_loop = { array = global.security_council_members value = v index = i
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { v = TAI } } set_variable = { global.security_council_members^i = CHI } } }
	for_each_loop = { array = global.p5_sc_members value = v index = i
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { v = TAI } } set_variable = { global.p5_sc_members^i = CHI } } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { global.p5_sc_members = CHI } } } add_to_array = { global.p5_sc_members = CHI } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { global.security_council_members = CHI } } } add_to_array = { global.security_council_members = CHI } }
}

COLDWAR_CHI_join_general_assembly = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { global.UN_general_assembly = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.UN_general_assembly = THIS } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = united_nations_member } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = united_nations_member } }
	recompute_un_2_3_number = yes
	recompute_un_sc_required_yes = yes
}

COLDWAR_CHI_take_china_seat = {
	COLDWAR_CHI_replace_in_council = yes
	COLDWAR_CHI_join_general_assembly = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = p5_member } } add_ideas = p5_member }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_isolated_bastion }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_isolated_bastion
			add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_china_seat
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_seat_won
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_vote_lost
	if = { limit = { country_exists = TAI } TAI = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.12 days = 1 } } }
}

	COLDWAR_CHI_replace_in_council = yes
	COLDWAR_CHI_join_general_assembly = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = p5_member } } add_ideas = p5_member }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = TAI } TAI = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.13 days = 1 } } }
}

COLDWAR_CHI_leave_un = {
	if = { limit = { is_in_array = { global.UN_general_assembly = THIS } } remove_from_array = { global.UN_general_assembly = THIS } recompute_un_2_3_number = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = united_nations_member } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = united_nations_member } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = p5_member } remove_ideas = p5_member }
}

	hidden_effect = {

		if = { limit = { country_exists = TAI } TAI = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.11 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA NOT = { country_exists = TAI } NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_dual_representation_proposed } } USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.10 days = 2 } } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.9 days = 31 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHI_raise_bloc_tier = {
	# COLDWAR_CHI_new_tier is set before the call; the tier never falls
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_bloc_tier < COLDWAR_CHI_new_tier } }
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_bloc_tier = COLDWAR_CHI_new_tier }
		hidden_effect = { mdcw_cw_refresh_all_bloc_effects = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHI_clash_milestones = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_frontier_clashes > 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_3 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_3
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_purged_officers }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_purged_officers
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_purged_officers_blooded
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_rehabilitated_commanders }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_rehabilitated_commanders
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_rehabilitated_blooded
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_frontier_clashes > 4 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_5 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_5
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_korean_war_arsenal }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_korean_war_arsenal
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_korean_war_arsenal_blooded
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind_tested
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_frontier_clashes > 7 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_8 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_8
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_new_tier = 3 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHI_bloc_tier_3_tt
		COLDWAR_CHI_raise_bloc_tier = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_frontier_clashes > 11 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_12 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_milestone_12
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind_veteran
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind_tested }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind_tested
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_generation_behind_veteran
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_large_standing_army }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_large_standing_army
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_large_standing_army_lean
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHI_monthly = {
	if = { limit = { original_tag = CHI has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_initialized }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_red_sun check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_two_line > -0.40 } }
			add_power_balance_value = {
				id = COLDWAR_CHI_two_line_bop
				value = -0.01
				tooltip_side = COLDWAR_CHI_two_line_bop_left_side
			}
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_two_line = -0.01 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CHI_two_line min = -1 max = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_hk_1997_agreed NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_hk_1997_done } date > 1997.6.30 }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_hk_1997_done
			595 = { owner = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.53 } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_macau_1999_agreed NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_macau_1999_done } date > 1999.12.19 }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_macau_1999_done
			1106 = { owner = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.54 } } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CHI_reconcile_pairs = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_CHI_weekly = {
	if = { limit = { original_tag = CHI has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_initialized }
		COLDWAR_CHI_weekly_payments = yes
	}
}
